hero_tagline: Copy and paste sleepy kaomoji: drowsy, dozing, and fast-asleep Japanese text faces. Click any face to copy it instantly.
intro: Sleepy kaomoji (also spelled kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces for every stage of tired: heavy eyelids, mid-yawn, and sound asleep with a trail of zzz. A sleepy kaomoji such as (˘ω˘) or (-_-) zzz is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and chats. Browse by drowsiness below and click any face to copy it instantly. Whether you search "sleepy kaomoji," "sleep kaomoji," or "kaomoji sleepy," every face here is free to copy and paste. ꒳ comes from Yi, so a device without a font for it shows a box in its place.
